ending_and_cta: Last 3 s: a child colouring with the burned-in text 'הקובץ יעלה לקבוצת הווטסאפ תהנו!'. Caption: the worksheet file will be uploaded the next day to the WhatsApp group and asks 'למי לשלוח קישור הצטרפות לקבוצה?' (comment to get the join link).
price_or_code: none; the caption says to run and buy, with no price or link visible.
convincing: Interpretation: the spinning wheel is a strong visual, the gan setting adds teacher credibility, and the free file offered through a WhatsApp group is a clear lead magnet.
weak_or_overproduced: Interpretation: the product is never named or priced in the video itself; the voice is missing so the benefits come from text only; the graphic cards look like stock templates; 2,632 plays (public count).
lumebook_lesson: Interpretation: the lead-magnet CTA (a free printable through a WhatsApp group or DM) is a replicable mechanic that works without a child or product on camera, and the text-only format needs no speech recording; a LumeBook version could offer a free printable story-prompt page.
solo_without_child: yes: the spin, flat-lays and text cards need no child; children's hands appear only in two short inserts.
not_verified: What 'תבל' refers to (store or brand); whether the creator sells the wheel or the worksheets; whether she is paid by the seller; whether the graphic cards were made by her; the exact music. Transcript is only 'תודה רבה' across the whole video, treated as no speech.
